title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Modernizing analytical reports for inventory
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 modernizes inventory reports by replacing RDL layouts with Excel and Word formats, adding a new Item Age Composition report, and deprecating older redundant reports to simplify reporting and analysis.
key_points: Inventory reports now use Excel and Word layouts instead of outdated RDL formats for easier analysis and editing
A new Item Age Composition by Quantity and Value report provides deeper insights into aging inventory
Six inventory reports have been modernized including Inventory Top 10 List, Item Availability, and Inventory Purchase Orders
Three older reports are being deprecated including Item Age Composition-Value and Items with Negative Inventory to reduce redundancy
